items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Same men -- Lockjaw, what's his name, with his wa-wa, and all --

ctx.x: No, no, the whole band won't make it. I heard them in Rotterdam. And they had a drummer out of Detroit. I don't know what his name was. And, oh, I've never heard the band sound so bad. Same men -- Lockjaw, what's his name, with his wa-wa, and all --
